messages.subject: Encoding issues with shinyapps and data table
parts:
I have an app on shinyapps that includes a data table (made via renderDataTable). One of the column in the table includes both capital and lower case letters. I would like to preserve this, but as it stands when I sort on that column the capital letters all sort before the lower case letters. I would like to not change the table entries. 

I am writing the app on a windows machine - so presumably there is an issue with the encoding - it works fine locally. I have saved my ui, server etc files to utf-8 as well as a .csv file that is used but still it does not work. Do I need to alter the system locale in my app? If so how should I go about this - a change in server.r file before the shinyServer()  funciton? Do I need to worry about resetting the encoding? Or should I do something else altogether?

Thanks

JP
